headline: Penix's return revives Falcons' attack in rout of Packers
summary: In his first game since tearing his ACL last November, Michael Penix Jr. sparked the Falcons by passing for 256 yards with a touchdown in a 35-14 rout of the Packers at Lambeau Field.

headline: LaFleur at a loss for answers to Packers' offensive woes
summary: The Packers are off to their worst start in coach Matt LaFleur's eight seasons after they were booed off Lambeau Field on Thursday night.

headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold: 'Striving' to make return Sunday
summary: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold was limited Wednesday as he returned to practice after missing most of the first two games because of a glute injury.
